questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। Scalar projection a·b̂=(8)×(3/5)+4(4/5)=(3×(8)+16)/5; b ইতিমধ্যে unit।

questions.question_bn: Springs k₁=11, k₂=22 N/m series-এ mass m। effective k কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Series 1/keff=1/k₁+1/k₂=3/(2×(11))⇒keff=2×(11)/3; parallel sum নয়।

questions.question_bn: Atz≪1,rest line 500nm,observed 507nm। c=3×10⁵km/s;approxrecessionvelocity কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। z=(λobs−λ₀)/λ₀=(7)/500,lowzv≈cz=3×10⁵(7)/500=600nkm/s। relativisticexactformulaonlyatlargerz।

questions.question_bn: Young β=3mm। central bright থেকে third dark-এর distance কত mm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Dark positions (m+½)β; first m=0, third m=2⇒(5/2)β=2.5×(3) mm।

questions.question_bn: Charge+2Cpotential 12 V→16Vquasistaticallymoved। external work কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। ElectricpotentialenergychangeΔU=qΔV=2nJ। quasistaticexternaleffortpositive; electricfieldworknegativeofthis।

questions.question_bn: Same ideal gas pressure 3P, temperature 11T হলে density ratio new/old কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। ρ=PM/(RT)। same M-এ density∝P/T, তাই ratio 3/(11); absolute T দরকার।

questions.question_bn: SatellitecircularorbitR→2Rsameplanet। initial total energy−10 J। required energy increase কত J?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। CircularE=−GMm/(2r)। new Ehalf=−nJ; ΔE=−(5)−(−2×(5))=nJ। kinetic ও potential দুটোবদলায়।

questions.question_bn: R₀=9Ω at0°C, α=0.004°C⁻¹। at50°C R কত Ω?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। R=R₀(1+αΔT)=(9)×(1+0.2)=1.2×(9)। coefficient dimension ব্যবহার করতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: একই distance-এর প্রথম half speed 3, দ্বিতীয় half speed 6 m/s। average speed কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Equal distances-এ harmonic mean 2v₁v₂/(v₁+v₂)=4×(3)/3। arithmetic mean শুধু equal times-এ।

questions.question_bn: Crossed fields E=9 V/m,B=3T। undeflected particle speed কত m/s?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Opposite electric/magnetic forces cancel qE=qvB⇒v=E/B=(3)। charge ও mass cancel।

questions.question_bn: Ideal Atwood mass 7 kg ও 21 kg,g10। rope tension কত N?

questions.question_bn: Cell emf 7 V ও internal r=2Ω। variable external R-এ maximum delivered power কত W?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। P=ε²R/(R+r)²; maximum R=r। Pmax=ε²/(4r)=(7)²/8; total circuit power নয়।

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻9M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(9)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=7D make 120°। net dipole কত D?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Vector resultant 2μcos60°=μ=nD। linear 180°-এ zero; dipoles scalar যোগ নয়।

questions.question_bn: Exothermic reaction-এর K temperature বাড়ালে কীভাবে বদলায়?
questions.explanation: Heat product হিসেবে ধরলে T increase reverse reaction favour করে। van’t Hoff ΔH<0-তে dlnK/dT negative।

questions.question_bn: Atomic number 23, charge 3+। electron count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Neutral electron=Z। cation 3+ means তিন electron lost: Ne=Z−3=(13)+7; proton unchanged।

questions.question_bn: (NH₄)₂SO₄ sample 2640g। Nmass কত g? N14,H1,S32,O16
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Molar mass 132g/mol,samplenmol। each 2N⇒Nmass 2·14×(20)=28ng; fertilizer Npercentage 28/132×100।

questions.question_bn: Balanced half-reaction coefficients double করলে E° কী হয়?
questions.explanation: E°intensiveproperty। ΔG° ও n দুটো double; E°=−ΔG°/(nF) unchanged। Gibbsenergyadd করে cellpotentialderive করতে হয়।

questions.question_bn: Phenol bromine-water excess-এ কী দেয়?
questions.explanation: OH stronglyactivating ortho/para director; brominewater-এ without catalyst threeactivatedpositions substitute হয়ে whiteprecipitate আসে।

questions.question_bn: 7 mol simple mono aldehyde (formaldehyde নয়) excess Tollens reagent reduces। Ag produced কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। Aldehyde→carboxylate oxidation 2electrons; each Ag⁺1electron নেয়। ফলে 1aldehyde→2Ag, total 2×(7) mol।

questions.question_bn: Stock 9M। first 10fold,then 5folddilution। final molarity কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Sequentialdilutionfactorsmultiply 10×5=50। finalC=Cstock/50, factorsaddition 15 ভুল।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas collected over water total pressure 34k Pa, water vapour 2k Pa। dry gas partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Dalton total P=Pdry+Pwater। dry pressure=Ptotal−Pvapour=(14)+18k Pa; vapour pressure বাদ দিতে হয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Food wet mass 310g,dry mass 248g। wet-basis moisture content কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 31। Wet-basis moisture=(wet−dry)/wet×100=2×(31)/(10×(31))×100=20%; dry-basis হলে 25%।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Butan-2-ol-এর chiralcentre কোন carbon?
questions.explanation: Carbon 2 attachedOH,H,CH₃,C₂H₅ fourdifferentgroups। tetrahedralstereogeniccentre yieldsenantiomerpair; othercarbonsnotfourgroups।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Principal shell n=22। maximum orbital count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Shell includes l=0…(22)−1। orbital sum Σ(2l+1)=(22)²। electron capacity 2×(22)², orbitals নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=13 mol,H₂=26 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(13))/3,availableN₂(13) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(13)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 68mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 17mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। HClconsumed=4×(17)−(17)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: At fixedT Henry c=kP, dissolved gas concentration c₀ atP₀। P=25P₀ হলে concentration কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Stated Henry form c=kP linear। sameT,k-এ pressure factor (25) gives concentration factor (25); alternative H conventions আলাদা হতে পারে।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 400g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। 10%w/w means 100g solution-এ 10g Na Cl। salt 10×(4) g; remaining water 90×(4) g।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Cu²⁺electrolysistheoreticalmass 85g,actual 68g। current efficiency কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Currentefficiencyactualdesireddeposit/theoretical same charge=4×(17)/(5×(17))×100=80%; sidereactionsconsumeothercharge।

questions.question_bn: Gas volume 26L at300 K,1atm। final 600 K,4atm। final volume কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 26। Fixed gas amount combined law V₂/V₁=(T₂/T₁)(P₁/P₂)=2·¼=½। Celsius ব্যবহার নয়।

questions.question_bn: এক molecule-এ 18ester linkage;0.5 mol sample complete alkaline hydrolysis। OH⁻ needed কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। প্রতিটি ester bond cleavage-এ 1OH⁻ stoichiometric consume।0.5 mol molecules×nlinkages=(18)/2 mol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Metalfeed 30 kg,smeltingyield 80%,purification recovery 90%। final metal কত kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Sequential recovery multiply 0.8×0.9=0.72।10nkgfeed→7.2nkg; percentageyieldsadd নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 17 mol triglyceride complete NaOH saponification-এ NaOH কত mol লাগে?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। প্রতি triglyceride-এ 3ester linkage। each 1 mol NaOH hydrolyses; total 3×(17) mol, glycerol ও উৎপন্ন।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: A→B ΔH=18kJ/mol; B→C ΔH=−27kJ/mol। A→C ΔH কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Hess law states enthalpy state function। steps add:2×(9)+(−3×(9))=−(9) kJ/mol; route independent।

questions.question_bn: Preservative stock 2%w/v। final 3000 mL0.10%w/v solution-এ stock কত mL?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 30। Concentration dilution C₁V₁=C₂V₂⇒Vstock=0.10·100×(30)/2=5×(30) mL; তারপর final volume adjust।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 18×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 18। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (18)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((18)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Gas equilibrium-এ inert gas constant volume,T-তে যোগ করলে reactant partial pressures কী হয়?
questions.explanation: Partial Pi=niRT/V। inert addition ni,T,V বদলায় না, total pressure বাড়লেও participating partial pressures unchanged।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 2H₂+O₂→2H₂O। H₂=36 mol,O₂=12 mol। remainingH₂ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 12। O₂limitingn moluses 2nH₂। initial 3×(12) minusconsumed 2×(12) leavesn mol; product 2×(12) আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: van der Waals gas n=24 mol,b=0.04L/mol,V=24L। available volume V−nb কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 24। Excluded volume correction nb=0.04nL। available V−nb=(24)−0.04×(24)=0.96nL; attraction term আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: CH₄combustionreleases 890kJ/mol; amount 15 mol,burnerefficiency 80%। useful heat কত kJ?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 15। Totalcombustionheat 890nkJ। useful fraction 0.8⇒712nkJ; heatrelease sign separate from positive useful amount।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Agdeposit 1512g,Qsame Cu²⁺cell,MAg108,MCu64। Cudeposit কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 14। Agmoles=(14),electronmoles=(14)। Cu=(14)/2 mol×64=32ng। Faraday second equivalent mass relation।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Reaction-এ bonds broken total 1700kJ/mol, formed 2040kJ/mol। approximate ΔH কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Bond enthalpy estimate ΔH=Σbroken−Σformed=100×(17)−120×(17)=−20×(17); bond formation releases energy।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ore130g contains 80%Fe₂O₃। complete Feproduction, MFe₂O₃160,MFe56। iron mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Pure oxide 8ng; Femassfraction 112/160=0.7。 actual iron 8×(13)·0.7=5.6ng; impurityremovedfirst।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=9, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।
